home.title: Konaseema Essence
home.subtitle: Coconut Heaven of Andhra
home.description: Discover the pristine beauty, rich culture, and authentic traditions of Konaseema - God's Own Delta
home.aboutDescription: Konaseema, often called the 'Kerala of Andhra Pradesh', is a region blessed with lush coconut groves, serene backwaters, and a unique riverine culture. Nestled in the Godavari delta, it's a paradise for nature lovers and culture enthusiasts.

riverLife.title: Godavari River Life
riverLife.description: Life in Konaseema revolves around the Godavari River. From boat races to fishing traditions, the river is central to the region's identity.

boatTraditions.title: Boat Traditions
boatTraditions.description: Traditional boat making and river navigation are integral parts of Konaseema's heritage.

coconutPlantations.title: Coconut Plantations
coconutPlantations.description: Vast coconut groves line the delta, providing livelihood and defining the landscape.

festivals.title: Festivals
festivals.description: Godavari Pushkaralu and other regional festivals celebrate the river and local traditions.

villageLife.title: Village Traditions
villageLife.description: Experience authentic village life with traditional customs and community celebrations.

pootharekulu.name: Pootharekulu
pootharekulu.description: Paper-thin sweet from Atreyapuram, made with rice starch and jaggery.

gongura.name: Gongura
gongura.description: Tangy sorrel leaves curry, a staple in Andhra cuisine.

chepaPulusu.name: Chepa Pulusu
chepaPulusu.description: Traditional fish curry with tamarind and spices.

mangoPickles.name: Mango Pickles
mangoPickles.description: Spicy and tangy pickles made from raw mangoes.

riceDishes.name: Rice-based Dishes
riceDishes.description: Pulihora, curd rice, and other traditional rice preparations.

coconutSweets.name: Coconut Sweets
coconutSweets.description: Delicious sweets made from fresh coconut.

toddy.name: Toddy Palm Items
toddy.description: Traditional beverages and dishes from toddy palm.

amalapuram.name: Amalapuram
amalapuram.title: The Cultural Hub
amalapuram.description: A major town in Konaseema known for its temples, markets, and riverfront.

dindi.name: Dindi Resorts
dindi.title: Riverside Paradise
dindi.description: Beautiful resorts along the Godavari offering serene views and boat rides.

yanam.name: Yanam Coastline
yanam.title: Coastal Beauty
yanam.description: Pristine beaches and coastal areas where the Godavari meets the Bay of Bengal.

papikondalu.name: Papikondalu Gateway
papikondalu.title: Nature's Wonder
papikondalu.description: Gateway to the famous Papikondalu, known for scenic river cruises.

atreyapuram.name: Atreyapuram
atreyapuram.title: Sweet Village
atreyapuram.description: Famous for Pootharekulu, this village is a must-visit for food lovers.

culture.title: Rich Culture
culture.description: A unique blend of riverine and coastal traditions.

nature.title: Natural Beauty
nature.description: Lush greenery, backwaters, and pristine landscapes.

agriculture.title: Agriculture
agriculture.description: Fertile delta lands supporting rice, coconut, and other crops.

life.title: Way of Life
life.description: Simple, peaceful, and deeply connected to nature.
